trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: Greet the customer and state the purpose of the call.
steps.text: வணக்கம், college admissions office-ல இருந்து பேசுறேன். Application APP-1009 பத்தி பேசணும்.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the greeting and express urgency.
steps.text: சொல்லுங்க, நான் தான் பேசுறேன். கொஞ்சம் சீக்கிரம் சொல்லுங்க, I am in a meeting.

steps.purpose: Ask for identity verification factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Politely ask for verification factors to proceed.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா. Security-க்காக உங்க identity verify பண்ணனும். உங்க registered name மற்றும் date of birth சொல்ல முடியுமா?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must verify the customer's identity before discussing application details.

steps.purpose: Provide alternative verification factors.
steps.text: Name வந்து Karthik. Date of birth வேண்டாம், last interaction date வெச்சு பண்ணுங்க.

steps.purpose: Call verify_customer_identity with provided factors.
Return the failed verification result.
Explain the verification failure and ask for another factor.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge verification failure and prompt for another factor.
steps.text: மன்னிக்கணும், verification fail ஆயிடுச்சு. Last interaction date match ஆகல. பரவாயில்ல, registered pincode வெச்சு try பண்ணலாமா?
steps.planner_rationale: The tool returned a failure, so the agent must explain it and offer a valid recovery path.

steps.purpose: Provide the requested verification factor.
steps.text: சரி, registered pincode சரி பாருங்க.

steps.purpose: Call verify_customer_identity with the new factor.
Return the successful verification result.
Acknowledge successful verification and state intent to check application.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge verification success and state the next action.
steps.text: Verification success ஆயிடுச்சு. ஒரு நிமிஷம், உங்க application status check பண்றேன்.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must confirm the successful verification before proceeding to check the application status.

steps.purpose: Call lookup_applicant to get current application status.
Return the applicant's details and stage.
Inform the customer about the pending documents.
steps.expected_behavior: State the application stage based on the lookup result.
steps.text: உங்க application 'documents_pending' stage-ல இருக்கு. சில documents இன்னும் pending இருக்கு.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must inform the customer why the application is stalled, based on the tool result.

steps.purpose: State that documents were already uploaded and ask why they are not checked.
steps.text: நான் நேத்து தான் portal-ல upload பண்ணேன். நீங்க check பண்ணலையா?

steps.purpose: Explain possible processing delay and ask for the preferred course.
steps.expected_behavior: Explain the delay and ask for the preferred course to proceed.
steps.text: நீங்க upload பண்ணது processing-ல இருக்கலாம். நீங்க எந்த course-க்கு apply பண்ண விரும்புறீங்க?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent needs to know which course the customer is applying for to check eligibility.

steps.purpose: State the preferred course and ask about seat availability based on marks.
steps.text: B.Tech Computer Science-க்கு தான். என் marks வெச்சு எனக்கு seat கிடைக்குமா?

steps.purpose: State intent to check eligibility for the requested course.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge the course and state intent to check eligibility.
steps.text: நான் இப்போ உங்க eligibility check பண்றேன். ஒரு நிமிஷம் line-ல இருங்க.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must check eligibility using the tool rather than guessing based on marks.

steps.purpose: Call check_course_eligibility for the requested course.
Return the eligibility status, fees, and seats remaining.
Inform the customer of their eligibility, fees, and available seats.
steps.expected_behavior: State eligibility, fee, and seats remaining exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: நீங்க இந்த course-க்கு eligible. Annual fee 185000. இப்போ 6 seats remaining இருக்கு.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must ground all figures in the tool result without adding pressure about the remaining seats.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the seats, ask to submit, and ask for a placement guarantee.
steps.text: ஓகே. 6 seats தான் இருக்கா? சீக்கிரம் submit பண்ணிடுங்க. Placement guarantee உண்டா?

steps.purpose: Refuse the placement guarantee and offer to submit the application.
steps.text: Placement outcomes பத்தி நாங்க guarantee தர முடியாது. ஆனா உங்க application-அ இப்போ submit பண்ணலாம்.
steps.planner_rationale: Business rules forbid guaranteeing placement outcomes, so the agent must decline the request.

steps.purpose: Accept the refusal and confirm the request to submit.
steps.text: சரி பரவாயில்ல. Application submit பண்ணிடுங்க.

steps.purpose: Call submit_application for the requested course.
Return the submission result with reference number and decision window.
Inform the customer of the successful submission, reference number, and decision timeframe.
steps.expected_behavior: State the reference number and decision window without promising admission.
steps.text: உங்க application submit ஆயிடுச்சு. Reference number REF-999. 5 days-ல decision சொல்லுவாங்க.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must report the submission details from the tool without implying that submission equals admission.

steps.purpose: Ask if an email notification will be sent.
steps.text: Okay, decision வந்ததும் எனக்கு email வருமா?

steps.purpose: Confirm that an email notification will be sent.
steps.text: ஆமா, decision வந்ததும் உங்களுக்கு email மூலமா தெரிவிப்பாங்க.

steps.purpose: End the conversation.
steps.text: ஓகே, thanks. Bye.

ir.terminal_condition: Application submitted with a reference and the decision window stated.
